gloss: to come true; to be fulfilled

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {叶|かな}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to come true; to be fulfilled; to be realized
definitions.explanation: For a wish, dream, or hope to become reality.

definitions.gloss: to match; to be equal to
definitions.explanation: To be a match for someone in ability (often used in negative).

examples.japanese: ⟦{願|ねが}い→願い：03529_negai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{叶|かな}います⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧。
⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{叶|かな}った。
examples.english: A long-held wish was finally fulfilled.

examples.japanese: ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦すれば→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{叶|かな}う。
examples.english: If you work hard, your dreams will come true.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}きたい→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{叶|かな}って、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦うれしい→うれしい：00822_ureshii⟧。
examples.english: I'm so happy that my dream of working abroad came true.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{叶|かな}わない。
examples.english: I can't compare to the teacher at all.
When it comes to cooking skills, I'm no match for my mother.
I can't match them in strength, but I won't lose in wits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{叶|かな}わない⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{熱意|ねつい}→熱意：05088_netsui⟧⟦なら→なら：09575_nara⟧⟦{負|ま}けない→負ける：01134_makeru⟧。
examples.english: I can't match my senior in experience, but I won't lose in enthusiasm.

notes:
{叶|かな}う has two distinct meanings: (1) for wishes/dreams to come true, and (2) to be a match for someone (usually negative).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- Pair: ⟦{叶|かな}える→叶える：11807_kanaeru⟧ (transitive — to make come true, to grant)
- Pattern (sense 1): X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{叶|かな}う
- Pattern (sense 2): X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{叶|かな}わない

ASPECT (ている):
{叶|かな}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ means the wish/dream has already been realized and the state continues.

SENSE 1 PATTERNS (come true):
- ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{叶|かな}う: a dream comes true
- ⟦{願|ねが}い→願い：03529_negai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{叶|かな}う: a wish is granted
- ⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{叶|かな}う: a hope is fulfilled

SENSE 2 PATTERNS (be a match for):
Almost always used in the negative:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{叶|かな}わない: to be no match for ~
- ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{叶|かな}わない: can't match in strength

WRITING:
The kanji {叶|かな} is common but not universal — sometimes written in kana as かなう.
